description: This file defines a logging observer class for tracking and logging activities related to Large Language Models (LLMs) within the Pipecat framework. It imports various frame classes, a base observer class, and services, and implements an asynchronous method to handle frame push events, logging different types of frames and activities.

classes.name: LLMLogObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and logs activities related to LLM frames, inheriting from BaseObserver.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles frame push events, logs different LLM-related activities based on frame type and direction.
